mission.title: Machines and Mammon
mission.description: Track down and delete Mammon, leader of the Demon Army gang.

npc.say: That's all I got, copper. You can't squeeze $info from an empty drive.
Good luck, tesoro! I'll be monitoring your progress...closely.
You are scheduled to speak with Agent Pace, operative.

phase.briefing:
As you are no doubt aware, {player}, we have...unfinished business on our hands. A recent city-wide investigation into the whereabouts of a case of valuables stolen from us ended in the discovery that the theft was perpetrated by the Exile program known as the General. The General had denied our allegations following the initial theft of the case.
It is...unfortunate that the General has allied himself with Zion, with whom we maintain a strict truce. This will make it difficult, but not impossible, to move against him. Certain plans that I cannot yet reveal are underway with respect to this goal.
But there is a much more...accessible target available. The Demon Army gang attempted to hinder our operation. You will proceed to their self-described "turf," Tabor Park, locate their leader, Mammon, and delete him.

enter.say: We had a report of a Demon Army sighting in that building. It's up to you to get some information out of them about Mammon's location.

done.say: That one was carrying some interesting code. See what they've got.

objective.text: Get the encrypted code from the Demon Army member

done.say: Encrypted data... They might have the decryption routine there somewhere. See if you can locate a computer system.

objective.text: Decrypt the code at the computer

done.say: Some data's coming up on that computer. Scan it for me.

complete.say: Cacophony I recognize; the rest of that is pretty cryptic. Let's go see what Gray can make of it.

phase.briefing:
That is an easily explained message, operative. "Cacophony," as you will no doubt recall, was the code-name you found used by the thieves to refer to their employer. The Oracle guessed that "Cacophony" was, in fact, the General; and she happened to be correct, as our operatives would prove.
"Darago" was the individual found carrying the evidence, assisted by Demon Army members. He was detected by one of our operatives, pursued across the city by our forces, and ultimately deleted by another of our operatives, with the help of many others.
The last name given, Robin, must be the individual carrying payment to the Demon Army for their services rendered to Darago. He is known Exile scum, working for the highest bidder. Question him concerning Mammon.

enter.say: I've got a couple Exile signals in there.

talk.say:
Who do you think you are? I ain't done no-- Agent Gray? Ohhhh crud. Oh no. No no nononono.
L-look, I pick up a package from one spot, and deliver it to another. That's all I know. You want the package and the location? Good, good! I never wanted 'em! But a program's gotta make a living somehow, right? H-here, just take the damn things!

done.say: Eesh. Get the package and the location notes from him. I hope he didn't rub too much scum off on them.

talk.say: Take them! Just take them already!

objective.text: Get the location notes from Robin

done.say: Ooh, that's a nice little chunk of encrypted $info, if I remember my crypto class. You'd better upload both of those items to me at a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the package at a hardline
Upload the location notes at a hardline

phase.briefing:
You are operating at a high rate of efficiency, {player}.
We calculate a 93.76% chance that Mammon will be present at the location marked on Robin's orders. Based on what we saw during the operation against Darago, he will almost certainly have a large group of Demon Army programs with him.
In consideration of the likely opposition, we are providing you with backup units. Report to the location indicated and meet with our liaison.

enter.say: I've got some high-powered programs in there. I love it when Gray lets us play with his toys.
Oh baby, the code stream just got cranked up to "Smokin'"! Doth mine eyes deceive me, or is Agent Pace in there? Now that's my kind of liaison.

talk.say: Ah, tesoro. I've been looking forward to seeing you. Louis Bonner and Leopoldon Royal are at your disposal for this operation. They will aid you in Mammon's deletion, but please, be careful. We wouldn't want a human of your abilities damaged over such a trivial matter as this rogue gang leader.

done.say: I wonder if Gray would mind if we just hung out with Pace for a while?

phase.briefing:
It took slightly longer than projected to complete that phase of the mission, operative. Are you functioning at optimal levels?
Proceed to the indicated area and delete Mammon. Additionally, we request that you delete any of his Demon Army programs that you encounter in the area.

enter.say: I've got some beefy Exile programs in there. They match the usual Demon Army profile, only quite a bit tougher. Except for one--that's probably Mammon. Wonder how he keeps the stronger programs under his control...

done.say: You shall die a thousand times for this impertinence, unbeliever!

objective.text: Kill all of the Demon Army programs

mission.finish:
Our thanks, {player}. That should serve to...dissuade any other Exile groups who may have been considering direct acts of civil disobedience. The System will not tolerate such disruptions.
It is unfortunate that Mammon and his cohorts successfully aided in the original theft of the case. We assure you that appropriate countermeasures are being taken to ensure the stability of the Matrix.
